Package neqsim.process.processmodel

Class RunDiagnostics

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.RunDiagnostics
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class RunDiagnostics extends Object implements Serializable
Diagnostics of the last run of a ProcessSystem or ProcessModel: wall-clock time, budget outcome (timed out, stopped, stalled), the unit that was running, and the recent residual history.
Version:
1.0
Author:
esol

  • Constructor Details

    • RunDiagnostics

      RunDiagnostics(RunBudget.Outcome outcome, String reason, String unitName, double elapsedSeconds, double maxRunTimeSeconds, int stallWindow, int passCount, double lastResidual, double bestResidual, int residualCount, List<Double> residualHistory)
      Creates a diagnostics record.
      Parameters:
      outcome - budget outcome
      reason - reason text
      unitName - unit that was running when the budget tripped, or the last unit started
      elapsedSeconds - elapsed wall-clock time in seconds
      maxRunTimeSeconds - configured time budget in seconds (zero if off)
      stallWindow - configured stall window (zero if off)
      passCount - number of passes or iterations
      lastResidual - last recorded normalised residual
      bestResidual - best recorded normalised residual
      residualCount - number of recorded residuals
      residualHistory - most recent residuals
